changes: Permission editor remains closable during loading and after a failed read, with an explicit retry action.
Permission saves use a synchronous lock and ignore late responses from closed editors.
Finance account lookup failures no longer hide management commission entries and rate settings.
Payment accounts can be retried independently; failed or unverified accounts cannot be used for payment recording.
Commission settings forms are disabled during saves to prevent silently losing edits made during an in-flight write.
Own-only commission views retain hidden recipient and director information; the empty table uses the correct column count.
